claims.evidence: Photo 0 and Photo 1 clearly show 'Nikon' and 'Zfc' engraved on the top plate; the body is a Nikon Z-mount camera, not Canon.

claims.claim: Nikon Z fc is a retro-inspired, SLR-style mirrorless camera
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows the classic retro dial-based styling consistent with the Zfc design.
Sensor specs cannot be confirmed from external photos; no sensor or spec label visible.

risks.risk: Seller misstates the brand as Canon while the photographed item is clearly a Nikon, raising doubt about whether seller actually possesses/understands the item or is running a mismatched/copy-pasted listing.
risks.proof: A video showing the seller holding the camera, powering it on, and reading the brand/model off the menu screen matching the physical body.
risks.if_unproven: treat as high fraud risk; do not price until identity mismatch is resolved

risks.risk: Unknown shutter count, sensor condition, and autofocus accuracy
risks.proof: A photo of the camera's shutter count from a diagnostic app or menu screen, plus a short video of autofocus acquiring focus on a moving subject
risks.if_unproven: priced as heavily used with unknown mechanical wear

risks.risk: Unclear whether kit lens (16-50mm) is included or only the third-party TTArtisan 35mm lens
risks.proof: A photo showing the Nikon kit lens box or the lens itself if claimed to be included
risks.if_unproven: priced as body + TTArtisan lens only, no kit lens

risks.proof: A screenshot of battery info from camera menu or charger diagnostic

risks.risk: Lens glass condition (scratches, fungus, dust) not verifiable from angles shown
risks.proof: Close-up photos of front and rear lens elements under backlight
risks.if_unproven: priced as having possible optical defects

risks.risk: No memory card, strap, or USB cable confirmed present
risks.proof: A photo laying out all included accessories with memory card/cables visible
risks.if_unproven: priced as body/lens/charger/battery only, no extras

risks.risk: Physical damage, dents, or corrosion not visible in given angles
risks.proof: Additional photos of bottom plate, mount flange, and sides under bright light
risks.if_unproven: priced as cosmetically unverified, assume moderate wear

proof_requests: Video of seller powering on the camera and showing the on-screen model/brand confirming it reads 'Nikon Zfc'
Photo of shutter count or diagnostic screen
Clear close-up photos of lens front/rear elements under light
Photo of all accessories laid out including any memory card, strap, or cables
Photos of camera bottom, sides, and mount for dents/corrosion
response.reason: The seller explicitly states the brand is Canon while the witnessed photos clearly and consistently show a Nikon Zfc, a core identity contradiction serious enough to suspect a mismatched or fraudulent listing before any pricing can proceed.
